-- Fungsi untuk Gojo

    local args = {
        "Gojo"

    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Change Character"):WaitForChild("ChangeCharacter"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

-- Fungsi untuk JK
local function changeToJK()
    local args = {
        "JK"
    }
    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Change Character"):WaitForChild("ChangeCharacter"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

-- Fungsi untuk Saitama
local function changeToSaitama()
    local args = {
        "Saitama"
    }
    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Change Character"):WaitForChild("ChangeCharacter"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

-- Fungsi untuk Yuta (TrueLove)
local function changeToYuta()

        "TrueLove"
    }
    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Change Character"):WaitForChild("ChangeCharacter"):FireServer(unpack(args))

        "Chara"
    }
    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Change Character"):WaitForChild("ChangeCharacter"):FireServer(unpack(args))

-- Fungsi untuk Builder

    local args = {
        "Builder"
    }
    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Change Character"):WaitForChild("ChangeCharacter"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

-- Fungsi untuk Admin

        "Admin"

end

-- Fungsi untuk Bunny

    local args = {
        "Bunny"
    }
    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Change Character"):WaitForChild("ChangeCharacter"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

-- ========== CONNECT BUTTONS TO FUNCTIONS ==========
GojoButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(changeToGojo)
JKButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(changeToJK)
SaitamaButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(changeToSaitama)
YutaButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(changeToYuta)
CharaButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(changeToChara)
BuilderButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(changeToBuilder)
AdminButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(changeToAdmin)
BunnyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(changeToBunny)

-- ========== HOVER EFFECTS ==========
local function onButtonHover(button, originalColor)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
        math.min(originalColor.R * 255 + 80, 255),
        math.min(originalColor.G * 255 + 80, 255),
        math.min(originalColor.B * 255 + 80, 255)
    )
end

local function onButtonLeave(button, originalColor)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = originalColor
end

-- Store original colors
local gojoColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 150)
local jkColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 150)
local saitamaColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 50)
local yutaColor = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 70)
local charaColor = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
local builderColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 180)
local adminColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
local bunnyColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 200)

-- Gojo hover
GojoButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() onButtonHover(GojoButton, gojoColor) end)
GojoButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() onButtonLeave(GojoButton, gojoColor) end)

-- JK hover
JKButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() onButtonHover(JKButton, jkColor) end)
JKButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() onButtonLeave(JKButton, jkColor) end)

-- Saitama hover
SaitamaButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() onButtonHover(SaitamaButton, saitamaColor) end)
SaitamaButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() onButtonLeave(SaitamaButton, saitamaColor) end)

-- Yuta hover
YutaButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() onButtonHover(YutaButton, yutaColor) end)
YutaButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() onButtonLeave(YutaButton, yutaColor) end)

-- Chara hover
CharaButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() onButtonHover(CharaButton, charaColor) end)
CharaButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() onButtonLeave(CharaButton, charaColor) end)

-- Builder hover
BuilderButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() onButtonHover(BuilderButton, builderColor) end)
BuilderButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() onButtonLeave(BuilderButton, builderColor) end)

-- Admin hover
AdminButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() onButtonHover(AdminButton, adminColor) end)
AdminButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() onButtonLeave(AdminButton, adminColor) end)

-- Bunny hover
BunnyButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() onButtonHover(BunnyButton, bunnyColor) end)
BunnyButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() onButtonLeave(BunnyButton, bunnyColor) end)

-- ========== NOTIFICATION ==========
game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "Character Changer";
    Text = "GUI Loaded Successfully! Created by Ez3by5pass | Modified by Redsky-Catl0l";

})
